salary_details.part time specialist: Rs 60,000/- (fixed) only per month (In case if willing for emergency call duty, Rs 15,000 charges payable for emergency visit, and Rs 800 per hour payable for extra hours above 16 hours in week)
salary_details.details: No other allowances like HRA, NPA etc. are payable for Senior Resident posts. Additional working hours or emergency visits for specialists are subject to justification by the Medical Superintendent.

selection_process: Selection will be made through a walk-in-interview conducted at ESIC Hospital
Korba (C.G.). Candidates must report between 09:00 AM and 11:00 AM on 14 October 2026.
how_to_apply: Download the application form (Annexure 1) from the official website.
Fill out the application form completely in block/capital letters in your own handwriting.
Attach self-attested copies of all required educational, experience, caste, and birth certificates along with two recent passport-size photographs.
Submit the duly filled application form via email to [email protected] or submit hard copies at the Office of MS ESICH Korba on or before 10 October 2026 up to 12:30 PM.
Attend the walk-in-interview on 14 October 2026 with all original documents and one set of self-attested photocopies.
important_instructions: Recruitment is purely on a contractual basis and selected candidates will have no claim for regularization of service in ESIC Hospital Korba. Private practice of any kind is not allowed for full-time contractual specialists. Selected candidates must deposit security money of Rs 30,000/- through Demand Draft in favor of "ESI Fund Account No.1", Korba at the time of joining. Selected candidates must hold a professional indemnity policy with a minimum sum assured per annum ranging from Rs 10 lakhs to Rs 30 lakhs depending on the specialty. Selected candidates will have to sign a contract of agreement on a bond paper worth Rs 100/- at their own cost. Candidates currently in service must submit a "No Objection Certificate" from their employer at the time of interview. Hostel accommodation or quarters will not be provided by the hospital. Either party may terminate the contractual engagement by giving one month's prior notice or paying one month's remuneration in lieu thereof.

Selected candidates must hold a professional indemnity policy with a minimum sum assured per annum ranging from Rs 10 lakhs to Rs 30 lakhs depending on the specialty. Selected candidates will have to sign a contract of agreement on a bond paper worth Rs 100/- at their own cost. Candidates currently in service must submit a "No Objection Certificate" from their employer at the time of interview. Hostel accommodation or quarters will not be provided by the hospital. Either party may terminate the contractual engagement by giving one month's prior notice or paying one month's remuneration in lieu thereof.

faq.question: Q1. What is ESIC Hospital Korba Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification issued by ESIC Hospital Korba to fill 31 vacancies for Contractual Full Time Specialist, Part Time Specialist, and Contractual Senior Resident (Full Time) posts through a walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available in ESIC Hospital Korba Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 31 vacancies are available, comprising 13 vacancies for Specialists and 18 vacancies for Senior Residents.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form via email or at the Office of MS ESICH Korba is 10 October 2026 up to 12:30 PM.

faq.question: Q4. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held on 14 October 2026 from 10:00 AM to 04:00 PM, with reporting time between 09:00 AM and 11:00 AM.

faq.question: Q5. What is the venue for the interview?
faq.answer: The interview will take place at ESIC Hospital, Korba (C.G.).

faq.question: Q6. What is the qualification required for Specialist posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS with a PG Degree or equivalent/PG Diploma in the concerned specialty from a recognized university and registration with the Medical Council of India or State Medical Councils.

faq.question: Q7. What is the upper age limit for Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The upper age limit for Senior Resident posts is 45 years as on the date of interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary offered for Full Time Specialist posts?
faq.answer: Full Time Specialists receive a consolidated remuneration of Rs 1,14,955/- per month for a z category city.

faq.question: Q10. Can applications be submitted online?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to submit duly filled application forms via email to [email protected] or submit hard copies at the Office of MS ESICH Korba.
